aboutMore: ok sooo stuff i never put in my about me. my big sister marisa does hair at a salon called Shear Delight n shes the reason i can tease literally anything, she taught me on a mannequin head named Priscilla w/ a rat tail comb. i have 11 kandi on my left wrist n 9 on my right n every single one was traded in person (mail kandi doesnt count, thats just jewelry). when it storms in tampa (every day, 4pm) i lie on my bed w/ a hello kitty pillow n a flashlight n watch it like its tv. also lexi is the one who named me kitty. its a whole story. its a love story. =^.^=

blog.title: how to tease (a tutorial by me n my sister marisa)
blog.body: ok everyone keeps asking so. here r the steps, directly from marisa, who does hair for a living n has seen things. 1. START DRY. wet hair + rat tail comb = crying. 2. section it. top, crown, back. clip 2 of the 3 up. marisa says 'u cant boss a whole head at once.' 3. take a piece about 2 inches wide, hold it STRAIGHT UP, n comb DOWN toward the scalp. short little strokes. like ur sweeping a tiny floor. 4. spray. aqua net. yes the pink can. 5. repeat on every section. thats the 45 minutes. 6. smooth only the top layer w/ a brush, gently, like ur petting a cat that bites. 7. clip in the coontails. 8. spray again. marisa's 3 commandments: never sleep w/ it in. never use the crimper on wet hair. n take it out w/ conditioner, NOT violence. i broke #3 last tuesday. marisa called me from the salon n said 'i can hear it through the phone.' she cant. but she was right. u can make anything tall if u believe in it n have a can of hairspray n a sister.

blog.title: hurricane watch: a go-bag (a love letter to my hair)
blog.body: ok so theres a storm 400 miles out n the news lady keeps pointing at a swirl. my mom says we have a PLAN (aunt gina's in brandon). she says pack a bag. HERE IS MY BAG: 1. sidekick charger (wall AND car). 2. 3 hello kitty pillows. the 4th is staying in the closet w/ the tag still on, shes a collectible. 3. 4 cans of hairspray bc the humidity is a WAR n my hair is the front line. 4. a flashlight shaped like hello kittys head. batteries: 2. 5. 11 kandi bracelets in a ziploc, 'in case.' 6. a pink water bottle (my dad said 'what about water' n i pointed at the bottle). 7. my toaster. no. ok my mom said no. 8. photos of lexi n misery. printed. 4x6. in a pouch. bc if the power goes out n the internet is gone i want 2 look at their faces. lexi txted me 'r u dead' at 6am (it hadnt even started). misery sent a pic of her cat in a tiny life jacket. i love my girls so much. nobody can pc anyone if the power goes out. that is a real emergency.

A+. liz: 0/47. she viewed 9 times. i can see u liz. adam: 47/47 in 11 SECONDS. every one says 'thx 4 the add.' i wrote back 'ok but what did u think of the one w/ the toaster' n he said 'its cute lol' n then 'ok that was a real one.' i think hes ok. i think hes just really quiet. i invited him to the mall. i am taking this very seriously.

blog.title: why nobody calls me kaitlyn (a short story)
blog.body: in 6th grade our homeroom had four kaitlyns. kaitlyn s, kaitlyn m, a katelyn w/ an E, n me. mr lindqvist would say 'kaitlyn?' n all four of us turned around like a nature documentary. picture day, my mom ran out of bobby pins so she put me in a hello kitty headband (the one w/ the ears). lexi was new. she sat behind me. she looked at the headband n said, really quietly, 'u look like a kitty.' n i said 'thank u.' n that was it. 'kitty' by lunch. by friday the whole class. misery showed up in 7th n said 'meow' n then 'rawr' n they have been mine ever since. if u ever see 'kaitlyn' on a form i think its a typo. its not. its my legal name. it just doesnt get called on much. i wrote this on my bed w/ a flashlight bc its raining. lexi is the reason i have a name that fits. also lexi, delete this if ur reading. no dont. ily.
